sections.title: Bringing Unit 13 together
sections.content: This lesson pulls together Unit 13: weather adjectives with idő van, the weather verbs süt and fúj, each season's own irregular time-form (tavasszal, nyáron, ősszel, télen), and using ha with the present tense to make a plan depend on the weather.

sections.title: Weather and seasons, recapped
rows: in spring, in summer, in autumn, in winter

items.spanish: Nyáron nagyon meleg van, de télen hideg és havazik.
items.english: In summer it's very warm, but in winter it's cold and it snows.

items.spanish: Ha esik az eső, otthon maradok.
items.english: If it rains, I'll stay home.

items.spanish: Ha szép idő van, inkább kirándulunk.
items.english: If the weather's nice, we'd rather go hiking.

sections.content: The ha-clause needs no special tense — present tense in both halves does the job. And remember the seasons don't take -ban/-ben the way you'd expect: nyáron and télen use -on/-en, tavasszal and ősszel use -val/-vel.
